newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat up slightly, soy flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat up slightly, soy flat.

text.p: FOB wheat and corn basis values were slightly higher in nearby positions with some buying interest noted, several brokers said.
"Pakistan bought wheat today," one broker noted, referring to the purchase of 270,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat.
Soybean values were unchanged in quiet conditions but brokers pointed to Monday's strong USDA export inspections.
"Those were pretty decent numbers for soybeans," a broker said. USDA Monday said 28.2 million tonnes of soybeans were inspected in the week ended October 31.
